name: Harley-Davidson Model 165 / ST 165
intro: The bigger version of Harley's DKW-based two-stroke. Premix, a magneto and simple running gear.

B: It runs on premix. Mix the oil into the fuel at the ratio in the manual.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
